    ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D
  WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2019-01-01'
    AND i.DT_INTER < DATE '2021-01-01'
    AND m.SG_UF = 'RS'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER)
), comparacao AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(taxa_mortalidade_percentual) FILTER (WHERE ano = 2019) AS taxa_2019,
    MAX(taxa_mortalidade_percentual) FILTER (WHERE ano = 2020) AS taxa_2020,
    MAX(total_internacoes) FILTER (WHERE ano = 2019) AS internacoes_2019,
    MAX(total_internacoes) FILTER (WHERE ano = 2020) AS internacoes_2020
  FROM taxas
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN taxa_2020 > taxa_2019 THEN 'aumentou'
    WHEN taxa_2020 < taxa_2019 THEN 'caiu'
    ELSE 'permaneceu igual'
  END AS direcao,
  ROUND(taxa_2019, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_2019_percentual,
  ROUND(taxa_2020, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_2020_percentual,
  ROUND(taxa_2020 - taxa_2019, 2) AS diferenca_pontos_percentuais,
  internacoes_2019,
  internacoes_2020
FROM comparacao
